stem.text: Two sources of microwaves P and Q produce coherent waves with a phase difference of $180^{\circ}$. The waves have the same wavelength $\lambda$.

stem.alt: Dots labelled P, Q and S, with dashed lines joining P to S and Q to S.

stem.text: At the point S there is a minimum in the interference pattern produced by waves from the two sources. The distance (QS – PS) is called the path difference.
Which expression could represent the path difference?
